title: Make persisted Engram authority store keys non-UTF8 safe
outcome: EngramAuthorityStoreKey stores database_path as PathBuf inside JSON-persisted metadata. A non-UTF-8 canonicalized path can fail serialization of the whole metadata document and every later commit. Store a normalized serializable representation or isolate entry-level conversion failure.
acceptance: A non-UTF-8 P0-platform path cannot make unrelated TermAl state commits fail; authority identity remains stable for representable paths; persistence/reload tests cover the chosen degradation behavior.
disposal_reason: NOT PLANNED (backlog triage w-930e4d333f07, 2026-10-05; Greg's approval via Engram::Advisor #293). P3/P4, never started, no holder or children, untouched since before 2026-09-21, not reliability, data safety or pilot. The record is kept; reopen or re-file if it becomes relevant.
